title: SWITCH returns the result paired with the first value equal to the expression, or the else value
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( Product[Color] ), "Code", SWITCH ( Product[Color], "Red", 1, "Blue", 2, 0 ) )

source.quote: If there’s a match with a value , a scalar value from the corresponding result is returned. If there isn’t a match with a value , a value from else is returned.
source.supports: match gives the paired result, no match gives else

derivation: Red matches the first value: 1. Blue matches the second: 2. Green matches neither: the else value 0.
